command_line.description: List of command-line arguments passed directly to bfs(1). Each element must be a single shell-argument token (no spaces inside tokens); spaces must be handled by proper quoting outside this config system if needed. The order matters, and arguments may freely intermix flags, paths, and expressions per bfs(1) spec. Examples: ['-name', '*.txt', '-print'], ['-L', '/var', '-name', 'access_log'].
